title: STD-10: adopt OpenTelemetry metrics and logs (OTLP) beyond GenAI spans
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** STANDARDS-1 audit 2026-11-25: `otel-metrics` is planned in seed/standards/standards.json
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation standards --check && python3 -c "import json,sys;e=[x for x in json.load(open('seed/standards/standards.json'))['entries'] if x['id']=='otel-metrics'][0];sys.exit(e['support'] not in ('supported','partial'))"
**Status:** open

OpenTelemetry metrics and logs (OTLP) beyond GenAI spans. Liveness metrics, clock beats and cost readings exported as OTLP so any backend reads them; Cloudflare Workers can export OTLP natively.

Lands in `seed/worker/src/agentic/adapters/console-telemetry.js` (and its seed twin so every system inherits it). Move the register entry `otel-metrics` to supported with `how` paths and a passing test in the same change; replace the home-grown format, do not add a second one.

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation standards --probe otel-metrics`
**Prediction:** standards_supported >= 45 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** adopting a standard nothing in the system reads; a parallel format kept beside the old one.
